title: Short-term outcomes of the PreserFlo MicroShunt in Japanese patients with exfoliation glaucoma: a comparison with primary open-angle glaucoma using propensity score matching

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: exfoliation glaucoma and primary open-angle glaucoma, Japanese patients; first PreserFlo MicroShunt implantation with mitomycin C (one matched exfoliation eye with combined cataract surgery); propensity-score-matched groups (matching on age, sex, combined cataract surgery, preoperative IOP and medication score); retrospective, one eye per patient, at least 6 months of follow-up

groups.description: Exfoliation glaucoma eyes after PreserFlo MicroShunt with MMC, propensity-score-matched subset of the 31-eye exfoliation cohort (Table 4 column 'XFG (n = 24)'); eligible eyes could have had previous surgery without conjunctival manipulation (cataract surgery, ab interno outflow surgery, SLT, laser iridotomy)
Primary open-angle glaucoma eyes after PreserFlo MicroShunt with MMC during the same period, propensity-score-matched (Table 4 column 'POAG (n = 24)'); no previous glaucoma surgery or laser

series.notes: mean ± SD; rows 'Pre operation', 'Post operation 1W', '1M', '3M', '6M'; visit windows 1 week ± 2 days, 1 month ± 7 days, 3 months ± 28 days, 6 months ± 56 days (Methods), nominal times used; 1 week = 7/30.4375 months; per-visit n not reported
mean ± SD; same rows and visit windows as the exfoliation series; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: IOP of the full 31-eye exfoliation cohort at 1 week and 1, 3 and 6 months (Results text and Figure 1 box plots)
exclusions.reason: not tabulated (text and figure only); the matched exfoliation subset of Table 4 is extracted instead

exclusions.what: Table 1 (Tab1) preoperative IOP of the full exfoliation cohort
exclusions.reason: reference without a tabulated follow-up series for the same group

exclusions.what: Table 3 (Tab3) preoperative IOP of the matched groups
exclusions.reason: duplicate of the Table 4 'Pre operation' row; Table 4 cells are cited

exclusions.what: Table 4 columns C4 and C7 (p-values) and C5 to C6 (medication scores)
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible; medication scores are mentioned in notes only

exclusions.what: Kaplan-Meier complete and qualified success (Figures 3 to 6) and success percentages
exclusions.reason: Kaplan-Meier estimates and success proportions are not admissible

exclusions.what: Tables 2 and 5 (complications and interventions) and Table 6 (previous studies)
exclusions.reason: counts and literature values, not series of this study

notes: Tonometer: Goldmann applanation tonometer under topical anaesthesia, sitting position (Methods).
Reference: preoperative IOP tabulated with the preoperative glaucoma medication score (Tables 3 and 4), recorded as preoperative_medicated.

Needling (9 of 31 exfoliation eyes) and additional surgery (5 of 31) occurred during follow-up; the article states no outcome-defined exclusion from the mean IOP table, so the matched series are kept.
Propensity score matching used preoperative covariates only; it is not an outcome-defined selection.
Table 4 also tabulates the glaucoma medication score at each visit; not extracted.
Postoperative betamethasone drops were continued for 6 months (Methods).
